name: Slice Lattice Data
description: Read a paginated slice from a collection at any lattice path. For vectors: array of elements; for maps: array of {key, value}. Use after covia_list reveals a large collection. Example: g/Alice/timeline limit=5 (recent agent runs).

path.description: Any resolvable path pointing at a collection. Examples: 'v/ops/agent' (catalog sub-tree), 'w/events', 'g/my-agent/timeline'.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default 100).

maxSize.description: Max CAD3 encoding size (bytes) of the returned page (default 1000000). Distinct from covia_inspect's render budget — this caps the EXACT returned values. Slice never summarises: an oversize page is an error (reduce limit, or read an oversize entry directly / use covia_inspect for a summarised view).

type.description: Collection type: Vector, Map, or Set

values.description: The entries in the requested range. For maps, each entry is {key, value}.

count.description: Total number of entries in the collection (the returned page is in values).
